name: Malicious insider data theft
summary: A departing employee with legitimate access collects confidential data from internal repositories and cloud storage and takes it out of the organization.

attack_path.description: The employee uses their own valid account; no exploit is needed.
Documents are gathered from wikis, file shares, cloud storage and the local workstation, then compressed.
Archives are copied to a USB drive or uploaded to a personal cloud account.
Permissions are changed or data is deleted to slow the investigation.

key_decisions: How to involve HR and legal without tipping off the employee
How to preserve evidence so it remains usable in legal proceedings
When to revoke access, and whether to do it before or after confronting the employee
Whether the stolen data triggers contractual or regulatory notification
